description: This file defines the 'Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource' class, which implements the 'Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Interface' for loading resource classes in the Zend Framework autoload mechanism. It manages resource types, namespaces, base paths, and provides methods for autoloading classes, configuring resource types, and instantiating resource objects.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource
classes.description: Implements resource class autoloading with configurable resource types, namespaces, and base paths. Supports class loading, resource management, and object instantiation based on resource type and name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource autoloader with given options, setting up namespace, base path, and registering with the main autoloader.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic 'get<Resourcename>()' method calls to retrieve resource instances.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Calculates the filesystem path for a given class name if it matches the namespace and component structure.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Attempts to autoload a class by including its PHP file if readable.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets configuration options, including namespace and resource types, from an array.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Sets the namespace prefix that this autoloader handles.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the configured namespace for this autoloader.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base filesystem path for resource classes.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path for resource classes.

methods.name: addResourceType
methods.description: Adds a resource type with its path and optional sub-namespace.

methods.name: addResourceTypes
methods.description: Adds multiple resource types at once.

methods.name: setResourceTypes
methods.description: Replaces all resource types with a new set.

methods.name: getResourceTypes
methods.description: Returns the current resource type mappings.

methods.name: hasResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource type is defined.

methods.name: clearResourceTypes
methods.description: Clears all resource types and component mappings.

methods.name: setDefaultResourceType
methods.description: Sets the default resource type for loading resources.

methods.name: getDefaultResourceType
methods.description: Gets the current default resource type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a resource class of a specific type and name, with caching for reuse.
